detail: No help page (spaMM-internal.Rd: not documented, used in a test). spaMM's recond is aster's echinacea (Geyer, Wagenius and Shaw 2007, Biometrika 94:415-426; aster 1.3-7's echinacea.Rd documents the columns), stacked long by its reshape, each trait missing past death or no flowering by spaMM's asNA.acyclic: all 5,130 cells equal. resp mixes survival (varb ld02 to ld04), flowering (fl02 to fl04) and head counts (hdct02 to hdct04) of 570 plants (id). test-mv.R fits recond by a fixed-effects fitmv only; tests/testthat/extralong/test-mv-extra.R, in an if (FALSE) block on aster's data, fits survival and flowering with (1|id) beside zero-truncated head counts, a model only in tests. The rows the formulas keep build as binary problems (1,374 survival records, only 34 plants varying; 1,182 flowering records of 412 plants, 199 varying), but the merge checks the response over the whole mixed column, so the stacked table has no registry form (hand check #162).
